extension.name: Mealie AI
extension.description: Extract the current browser page and send it to Mealie AI as a recipe or article.

header.subtitle: Extract the current page and send it to create a recipe or article.

settings.automatic-language: Automatic (Mealie site language, then browser language)

options.create-shopping-list: Also create an automatic shopping list

options.include-ai-tips: Add AI notes, tips, and ingredient-variety recommendations
options.include-mise-en-place: Add mise en place tasks with ingredients and tools
options.include-item-images: Find and save images for ingredients, tools, and shopping-list items

video.create-recipe: Create a recipe when a complete recipe is present

links.open-wanted-books: Open books to buy in Mealie
